description: This file provides utility functions related to proxy connections and SSL contexts within the urllib3 library vendor package. It includes functions for determining if an HTTP tunnel is needed through a proxy and for creating SSL contexts configured for proxies.

methods.name: connection_requires_http_tunnel( proxy_url=None, proxy_config=None, destination_scheme=None )
methods.description: Determines whether an HTTP CONNECT tunnel is required for a given proxy setup based on proxy URL, configuration, and destination scheme.

methods.name: create_proxy_ssl_context( ssl_version, cert_reqs, ca_certs=None, ca_cert_dir=None, ca_cert_data=None )
methods.description: Creates and configures a default SSL context for proxy connections, loading default certificates if applicable.
